name: Manami Himawari
source:
A troublemaking catgirl with a Kansai accent. Appointed unofficially as the "mascot" of her class.

She loves lollipops, and can often be seen sucking on one feverishly. Although she loves buying different types of lollipops and offering them to her friends, she has a somewhat odd sense of taste, so her friends usually end up disliking them.

A very active member of the swimming club, she usually wears her swimsuit even if there's no need.
